Why I Started Filming Foxes🦊 Seven years ago, I met a fox sleeping with its tongue sticking out. 🦊 That little moment completely changed the way I saw foxes. Since then, I’ve been going out almost every week to film them. At first, I simply enjoyed watching and filming them, then going home and editing the footage just for myself. But over time, I started wanting more people to see how fascinating foxes really are—their personalities, their strange little behaviors, and the quiet moments that often go unnoticed. So I began sharing my footage online. Every video is filmed and edited by me, and behind every clip are hours of waiting, traveling, observing, and sometimes simply hoping a fox will appear. I don’t know what the next encounter will bring, but that’s exactly why I keep going back.#fox #animals #wildlife #foxy #cute

The FIA World Endurance Championship and Toyota have teamed up for a brilliant promotional film celebrating the return of Toyota's Le Mans-winning TR010 Hybrid to Japan. The video appears to recreate the famous highway scene from Pixar's Cars, with four modified Toyotas surrounding the race car as it travels inside a transparent transporter toward Fuji Speedway. In Cars, a group of modified tuner cars surrounds Mack on the highway before DJ's music and Snot Rod's exhaust antics eventually cause Lightning McQueen to become separated from his transporter. WEC gives the sequence a real-world Toyota twist, using Japanese car culture to escort its championship-winning Hypercar home. The winning car is returning to Japan for the 6 Hours of Fuji weekend, where Toyota is celebrating its Le Mans triumph in front of its home crowa. #Toyota #Cars #lemans #pixar #fyp

“People tell us this is as good as it gets. I guess it’s hard for us to understand that now. It’s all we know. We’ve been friends since kindergarten. We barely planned anything for this trip. Most nights, we didn’t know where we were going to sleep until we got there. Sometimes we found a beautiful place in the mountains. Another night, we slept in a bus station with rats in the bathroom. We still have two years of school, and then we’ll start separate lives. Maybe we won’t have two whole weeks to travel together anymore. But I think we’ll still find time. I hope so.” — Aaron, Sören, Charlie, & Liam Basel, Switzerland Life on Film #lifeonfilm

“mY LiFE iS tOo bORinG tO fiLm” 🌚🙄 Stawwwwp it! I’m back with PART TWO because I need y’all to understand… your life does NOT have to be exciting to create good b-roll. Everyone has a unique story, and sometimes the most “normal” parts of your day are exactly what you should be filming. And that’s why I love b-roll content soooo much! It’s some of the easiest content to film, you can use it over and over and over again, AND you don’t need to create some elaborate setup just to get the shot. Your couch. Your desk. Making coffee. Getting ready. Working. Editing. Literally… film your life, cousin! #capcut #capcutpioneer #capcutnow 😭✨ Have you ever imagined turning your normal portrait into a deeply emotional “cry face” cinematic moment? This viral AI photo trend can transform your simple selfie into a realistic emotional close-up portrait filled with tears, feelings and storytelling vibes 🎞️💔. ဒီ AI effect လေးက သင့်ရဲ့ ပုံမှန် selfie တစ်ပုံကို sad but beautiful emotional portrait style အဖြစ် ပြောင်းလဲပေးနိုင်ပါတယ် 📸. Keep your real face identity, natural skin texture, unique facial features and original expression unchanged, while adding realistic watery eyes, soft tears, emotional gaze and a touching cinematic atmosphere. မျက်နှာပုံစံ၊ ကိုယ်ပိုင်အမှတ်အသားနဲ့ natural beauty ကို မပြောင်းဘဲ မျက်လုံးထဲမှာ မျက်ရည်လေးတွေ၊ soft emotion နဲ့ realistic feeling တွေ ထည့်ပေးပါ 🥹✨. Imagine yourself in a dramatic movie scene — teary eyes, gentle smile, soft shadows, emotional lighting and a powerful silent story behind your face 🎬. ဒီ style မှာ sadness နဲ့ beauty ကို ပေါင်းစပ်ထားတဲ့ feeling ရရှိပြီး တကယ့် movie character တစ်ယောက်လို ခံစားရစေပါတယ် 🌙. Create a realistic background that feels like a heartbreaking but beautiful memory: warm indoor lights, rainy window reflections, blurred city atmosphere, quiet room, soft cinematic background and emotional movie vibes 🌧️✨. Your photo should look like a frame captured from a romantic drama film or an unforgettable emotional scene. To create this viral AI “cry face” trend with ChatGPT or Gemini AI, upload your clear portrait photo and use this prompt: “Keep my face identity, facial features, skin tone and natural expression unchanged. Transform my portrait into a realistic emotional cry face cinematic photograph with watery eyes, subtle tears, soft emotional expression, realistic skin texture, dramatic lighting, movie scene atmosphere and high-detail portrait photography.” Add these AI keywords: “crying face portrait, emotional eyes, realistic tears, cinematic close-up, sad beauty aesthetic, dramatic portrait photography, soft film lighting, emotional movie scene, realistic skin details, shallow depth of field, ultra realistic photography” 📷💧. ဒီလို cry face AI effect မှာ realistic tears, emotional eyes, soft lighting နဲ့ cinematic mood တွေက အဓိကပါ။ ဒါတွေကြောင့် AI ဖန်တီးထားတဲ့ပုံလို မဟုတ်ဘဲ တကယ့် film scene တစ်ခုထဲက emotional moment တစ်ခုလို မြင်ရစေပါတယ် 🥺🎞️. Turn your simple photo into a powerful emotional memory that tells a story without words 💖. Share your cry face transformation on TikTok, Instagram or social media and let everyone feel the emotion behind your eyes ✨. Maybe your eyes have a story that only tears can tell… 😭📸#fyp #trend
